title: Corrective Forcing: Unified Post-Training for Diffusions and Flows in Generative Speech Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2609.24651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion and flow models, as promising generative paradigms for speech enhancement, face a training--inference mismatch: training uses analytical path states, whereas inference recursively evaluates models on self-generated rollout states along discretized sampling trajectories. This mismatch causes prediction and discretization errors to accumulate. To address it, we introduce Corrective Forcing (CoF), a post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions. CoF corrects clean-speech predictions on rollout states toward the ground truth under dynamic sampling schedules, exposing the model to varying inference conditions. It further regularizes local evolution using locally corrected counterfactual transitions as references for factual transitions. translated_title: 校正强制：生成式语音增强中扩散模型与流模型的统一后训练
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流模型作为语音增强领域前景广阔的生成范式，面临着训练与推理不匹配的问题：训练时使用的是解析路径状态，而推理时模型则在离散化采样轨迹上对自身生成的滚动状态进行递归评估。这种不匹配会导致预测误差和离散化误差不断累积。为解决这一问题，我们提出了校正强制，这是一种后训练范式，它迫使扩散模型和流模型从自身生成的滚动状态中学习并校正其预测。CoF在动态采样调度下，将模型在滚动状态上的干净语音预测校正至真实值，使模型接触到多变的推理条件。它还利用局部校正的反事实转移作为事实转移的参考，对局部演化进行正则化。通过以共享的干净语音预测参数化来表达模型输出，CoF将相同的后训练流程应用于扩散模型和流模型。
tldr: 提出校正强制（CoF）后训练范式，使扩散与流模型从自身生成的滚动状态中学习并校正预测，解决训练-推理不匹配导致的误差累积问题，并以统一流程提升生成式语音增强性能。
en_tdlr: Corrective Forcing (CoF) is a unified post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions, mitigating the training-inference mismatch and error accumulation in generative speech enhancement.
